purpose: Private learner accounts, preferences and validated progress using NoCodeBackend.
authorization: User approved server storage using NoCodeBackend

database.identity: SHA-256 of authenticated NCB user id; client identity header must match the verified session
database.payload: MEDIUMTEXT; bounded JSON request; canonical game replay for illustrated formats, canonical bounded state validation for RPG
database.concurrency: Append immutable expectedVersion+1; unique constraint chooses one writer. Read-after-write confirmation polls without duplicate writes. Older versions pruned only after confirmation; current version is the maximum.
database.retention: Current cloud snapshot per exact content hash and play kind; device recovery copy on explicit cloud restore; journal displays up to 100 slots

content: Included authored content or published, reviewed content from the existing private Sites workspace. Existing resource/job rows and quotas unchanged.
audience: Existing owner-private Sites hosting preserved. NCB learner identity is an additional application account inside that boundary.
limits: RPG cloud snapshots validate canonical state but are not action-history replay proofs; no RPG mastery observations
Learning observations are practice support, not grades or inferred mastery
No automatic generation on profile changes
Public multi-tenant release is not part of this change
superseded: Earlier proposed D1 learner migration was not implemented. Empty storage-only NCB instance 34968_mosaic_learner_storage retained unused after user requested NCB auth; active instance is mosaic_learning.
rpgBinding: Exact bundle hash of included world, settlement and included or owner-published chapter; no new tables

personalStudio.storage: Existing learner_profiles table: profile slot plus studio slot. No migration.
personalStudio.binding: Exact canonical pack ID and hash, reviewed activity keys, server-loaded profile snapshot. Published content also requires the existing Sites resource owner.
personalStudio.observations: At most 3 immutable starting answers and 80 practice attempts per programme, confidence and uncertainty separate; reflection at most 2000 characters, ungraded.
personalStudio.concurrency: All programme mutations use expectedVersion and the existing append/confirm/prune NCB store.
personalStudio.removal: Explicit programme removal writes a new studio version; old versions pruned best-effort. Does not remove profile, game saves, source resources or the NCB account.
personalStudio.export: Browser export includes current profile and programmes; existing resource and game exports remain separate.
personalStudio.privacy: Deterministic planner; learner profile is not submitted to a model. Existing generation requires an explicit workshop action.
personalStudio.identity: No new auth scope, tenant membership, sharing, tables, model changes or quota overrides.
